description: Framed art print. A lone astronaut walks across a wide desert landscape at golden hour, cinematic and quiet, retro sci-fi colors, solitude and wonder.
Framed abstract print. Saturated gradient color fields and geometric interiors, calm and modern, made for a living room wall.
Instrumental lofi hip hop track with dusty drums, warm Rhodes chords and vinyl crackle, for studying and late night drives.
